summary: Expanded the thermal-management/liquid-cooling node with a discovery bias away from obvious mega-cap AI leaders. The strongest underfollowed public-market candidates found in this pass are industrial HVAC and engineered-systems companies whose AI exposure is embedded in data-center cooling products, BASX/Airedale brands, cooling towers, chillers, CDUs, heat rejection, pumps, and heat-transfer capabilities. Vertiv remains the obvious reference anchor, but it is not included as a candidate because the pass prioritizes less obvious suppliers. MOD and AAON have the clearest direct evidence from company disclosures; SPXC has plausible direct data-center heat-rejection exposure; GHM is a speculative-shadow candidate because it has relevant heat-transfer/fluid-management capabilities but weak evidence tying those capabilities to AI data centers.
